description: This source file implements resource management for XR Audio SDK, including resource allocation, request handling, process monitoring, and inter-process communication via FIFOs and message queues.

methods.name: xraudio_resource_list_init
methods.description: Initializes the resource list in shared memory, resetting resource states and capabilities.

methods.name: xraudio_resource_list_get_head
methods.description: Returns the head of the resource list from shared memory.

methods.name: xraudio_resource_list_get_next
methods.description: Returns the next resource list entry after the given entry.

methods.name: xraudio_resource_thread
methods.description: Main thread function handling message queue, FIFO, and timer events for resource management.
